About the position

Roku’s Ads Product team develops advertising solutions across the Roku TV experience, The Roku Channel, Roku devices, and off-platform environments. The Senior Product Manager will own products for brand outcomes across Roku’s in-stream video and native advertising, enabling advertisers to optimize campaigns toward unique reach, awareness, recall, consideration, and brand lift—and to verify results through holdouts and third-party measurement.

The role includes defining cross-surface campaign planning, pacing, frequency capping, deduplicated reach, shared creative, and reporting. The product manager will work with data science and engineering to build optimization models for incremental reach, predicted lift, relevance, and frequency, and incorporate these into delivery, creative selection, pacing, and bidding. The role also involves designing brand-lift polls and holdout experiments, evaluating whether native engagement can provide earlier signals, and connecting Roku data with third-party measurement partners, panel-based currency, and marketing mix models.

The successful candidate will collaborate with the performance video product team to connect brand exposure with later conversions and inform budget decisions between brand and performance campaigns. They will work across engineering, data science, sales, research, and operations, while considering effects on inventory, pricing, buying methods, and the viewer experience. Roku generally works in-office Monday through Thursday, with Fridays generally flexible for remote work; some roles or office locations may require five days per week in the office.

Responsibilities
• Own the roadmap for products that let advertisers buy impressions across in-stream video and native advertising and optimize toward unique reach, awareness, recall, consideration, and brand lift.
• Define metrics connecting impressions to outcomes, including cost per incremental reach and lift per dollar.
• Define how cross-surface campaigns plan, pace, and cap frequency across video and native, including deduplicated reach, shared creative, and unified advertiser reporting.
• Partner with data science and engineering to define models for incremental reach, predicted lift, relevance, and frequency, and integrate them into delivery, pacing, creative selection, and bidding.
• Test whether native engagement signals provide an earlier read on lift and improve optimization models.
• Build holdouts and brand-lift polls into campaigns by default, including experimental design and sample sizing.
• Own how Roku data works with third-party measurement partners, panel-based currency, and marketing mix models so advertisers can evaluate results using their own tools.
• Work with the performance video product team to show how brand exposure affects later conversions and enable budgets to move between brand and performance based on results.
• Collaborate with engineering, data science, sales, research, and operations, and make products clear enough for sales teams and advertisers to explain.
• Assess the effects of products on video and native inventory, pricing, direct and programmatic buying, and the viewer experience.

Requirements
• 5+ years of product management experience, including experience with complex or platform-scale products.
• Experience with brand or upper-funnel measurement, such as brand lift, reach and frequency, incrementality testing, marketing mix modeling, or attention metrics; ability to read a lift study and question its sample size.

title: Director, AI and Machine Learning Engineering
description:
What Makes Us a Great Place to Work

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

Who You’ll Work With

You will be part of a team building Bain’s integrated suite of agentic decisioning tools that gives large organizations always-on intelligence across their most important growth decisions. The role sits at an intersection few organizations can offer: the analytical depth and client access of a top-tier consultancy, the technical ambition of a product company, and engineering work at the frontier of applied AI.

You will work inside Bain’s standing product team, building software that helps the world’s largest companies answer the questions that drive their business: where to invest, where to focus, and how to win. The impact of what you build is direct and immediate, and the platform compounds in value with every release.

The platform has two layers working together: an agentic core and a set of decision modules, each solving a distinct commercial problem. The build lifecycle is connected to the real world: as case teams work alongside clients across industries and geographies, that feedback flows straight back to engineering and into the product. Every client engagement makes the platform smarter, broader, and more resilient.

This is a startup inside an established company. You get genuine early-stage ownership and real influence over architecture and product direction, backed by Bain’s global scale, client relationships, and leadership commitment; the pace of a startup with the runway of a global firm.

We are looking for engineers who see how to make a product better and bring that instinct to every sprint without being asked, and who are comfortable with problems that do not have a known answer. The work involves real-time decision engines, cloud-native infrastructure, and data problems with no off-the-shelf answer. Experience with agentic systems matters: tool and context protocols such as MCP, evaluation harnesses, memory design, and entity resolution across messy enterprise data. This is applied AI in production, at scale, with real users depending on what you build. The field is moving quickly and the team is built to move with it, so the willingness to keep learning counts for as much as what you already know.

Where You’ll Fit Within the Team

The AI Engineer is a core builder of the Growth AI Performance System platform’s Agentic Core and Interface: the shared foundation that all three product modules are built on. This is not a module-level role; you are building the central intelligence layer: the agentic workflows, retrieval and knowledge pipelines, tool integrations, and interface infrastructure that every product in the suite depends on. Moving solutions from early POC and MVP through to scaled production deployments, you are responsible for the reliability, quality, and coherence of the systems that real client teams use every day.

You will work across the platform and product modules focused on marketing ROI, brand, and pricing strategy, translating the analytical and commercial questions that client teams are trying to answer into reliable, production-grade agentic systems that deliver those answers at scale.

The role requires both deep technical capability and genuine client awareness. You will engage directly with consulting teams and, at times, with senior stakeholders, presenting how the Agentic Core works, translating system design decisions into business terms, and using that feedback to make the platform better. The build loop here is tight: client engagement informs engineering, and every release makes the suite more capable.

This role sits at the intersection of research and production engineering. The problems are rarely solved by off-the-shelf tooling: they require judgment about when agentic approaches add real value, how to build systems that fail gracefully, and how to measure quality in ways that matter to real users on real client engagements.

What You’ll Do

Building the Agentic Core

• Build and own core components of the Growth AI Performance System Agentic Core, the shared intelligence layer that all product modules depend on, including multi-agent orchestration frameworks, tool registries, shared memory and state management, and the interface infrastructure that surfaces platform capabilities to users

• Build AI applications for enterprise use cases across the full delivery lifecycle, from rapid POCs and MVPs through to scaled production deployments, designing AI workflows that execute multi-step tasks reliably and safely – building evals to measure output quality, benchmark model performance, and validate reliability before and after deployment

• Implement agentic patterns with strong judgment about when they add real value; build robust agent capabilities including context engineering, memory and state management, reasoning and planning, reflection, orchestration, routing, tool selection, function calling, and tool integration, with clear separation of concerns so the tool ecosystem scales cleanly

• Design and build advanced retrieval and knowledge pipelines across diverse data structures (vector, keyword, hybrid, and graph-based), covering embedding generation and optimization, indexing strategies, metadata design, relevance tuning, caching, access controls, and source attribution

• Apply fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning techniques where they measurably outperform prompting and retrieval alone; run model experimentation and early-stage research to inform architecture decisions

• Integrate platform capabilities into enterprise environments, balancing quality, latency, cost, privacy, and adoption; build reusable components and accelerators that scale across all three product modules

Engineering quality and operations

• Engineer for real delivery across the full software development lifecycle: write clean, testable, maintainable code; build APIs and microservices for cloud-native deployment; implement MLOps, AIOps, and GenAIOps practices including CI/CD, reproducibility, environment parity, and versioning for models, prompts, and agents

• Build evaluation and observability for the Agentic Core: tracing and instrumentation of agentic execution, regression test suites, automated scoring pipelines, and iteration loops for prompt and policy optimization

• Design evaluation frameworks that track hallucination rate and factual consistency, relevance and retrieval precision/recall, latency and throughput, and cost per task; feed user signals and human feedback into continual improvement cycles and ongoing model updates

• Apply data science and ML skills as needed to materially improve platform performance or reliability: data preparation, feature engineering, model selection, training, validation, and reproducible evaluation pipelines

• Design for secure enterprise deployment: access controls, auditability, responsible handling of sensitive data, and responsible AI guardrails, including fallbacks, red-teaming, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) review; implement security, privacy, and governance requirements across all platform services; partner with Bain’s global Responsible AI and ethics teams to keep the platform aligned with firm standards

Internal stakeholder communication skills

• Engage directly with consulting teams and senior stakeholders to understand how the Agentic Core is being used, where it falls short, and what needs to change; translate that feedback into concrete engineering improvements

• Present complex agentic system design, tradeoffs, and implementation decisions to senior stakeholders, including C-suite and executive leadership, in clear, non-technical terms that build confidence in the platform

• Contribute to discovery sessions and solution shaping with case teams; operate as a credible, composed technical voice that connects engineering decisions to commercial outcomes; act as a thought partner on AI strategy, architecture choices, emerging capabilities, and implementation roadmaps

• Drive innovation through out-of-the-box thinking; participate in POCs and innovation workstreams to validate new tools and technologies; stay current with emerging AI and agentic trends and share learnings across the team

• Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, ethics, and infrastructure colleagues to build robust, compliant AI systems

• Mentor and upskill engineers and case team members on best practices in RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and AI safety

Technical

• Proficiency with MLOps and AIOps practices: CI/CD for AI services, versioning for models, prompts, and agents, automated evaluation pipelines, and observability for agentic systems

• Advanced prompt engineering, context engineering, and conversation design; strong grounding in evaluation design, experimentation frameworks, and data labeling strategies for LLM applications

• Solid system design and architecture skills, with deep familiarity with cost optimization and computational tradeoffs for LLM workloads

• Ability to apply data science and ML skills to improve system performance: feature engineering, model selection, training, validation, and reproducible evaluation pipelines

• Demonstrated commitment to responsible AI practices: access controls, auditability, bias awareness, and the judgment to know when a system is not ready to deploy

The role combines knowledge engineering and data analysis with applied reinforcement learning, and owns work end to end, from data and experiment design through training, evaluation, and reporting.

The ideal candidate brings practical reinforcement learning experience, strong engineering discipline, and the ability to collaborate closely with domain experts and communicate results to technical and non-technical audiences.

Sr. or Lead BI Developer Overview:

We are seeking an experienced BI Developer to design, develop, implement, and support data solutions that help the business make informed decisions. This position may be filled at the Senior or Lead level, depending on the selected candidate’s experience, technical expertise, and demonstrated leadership.

In this role, you will develop dashboards, reports, data extracts, governed datasets, ETL/ELT processes, data marts, and other BI solutions. You will work with business and technical partners to translate complex requirements into reliable, secure, supportable, and cost-effective data solutions. You will also help maintain development, testing, documentation, change management, data governance, security, and production support standards.

What You’ll Do

• Develop and support BI reports, dashboards, data extracts, governed datasets, and ETL/ELT processes.

• Support data integration, data mart, reporting, and analytics solutions from source systems through downstream consumption.

• Translate complex business requirements into technical specifications, source-to-target mappings, and solution designs.

• Perform complex data analysis to support requirements gathering, metric definitions, source validation, and data-quality reviews.

• Conduct unit testing and assist with output validation, reconciliation, and business acceptance criteria.

• Troubleshoot reports, data extracts, ETL/ELT processes, scheduled jobs, and production data solutions.

• Perform root-cause analysis for data, reporting, and pipeline issues and document resolution steps and preventive actions.

• Create and maintain technical documentation, including business rules, data lineage, technical specifications, runbooks, and support procedures.

• Support testing, user acceptance testing, change management, and release planning.

• Support data governance, metadata, lineage, data quality, access control, and reporting governance expectations.

• Identify opportunities to improve the performance, reliability, efficiency, automation, and supportability of existing solutions.

• Serve as a senior technical contributor or technical lead for projects, enhancements, and corporate initiatives.

What You’ll Bring:

• Advanced SQL skills using Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, or another leading relational database management system.

• Advanced experience developing reports and dashboards using tools such as Microsoft Reporting Services, Power BI, Business Objects, or Cognos.

• Strong experience developing ETL/ELT processes using Microsoft Integration Services or other data integration tools.

• Experience supporting data extracts, data integrations, data marts, governed datasets, and downstream reporting or analytics.

• Experience with dimensional data modeling and data warehousing methodologies.

• Experience designing or maintaining OLAP cubes, semantic layers, or data models.

• Knowledge of data-quality processes, including validation, exception reporting, reconciliation, and data-quality metrics.

• Working knowledge of production support practices, including scheduling, orchestration, monitoring, incident triage, root-cause analysis, and operational readiness.

• Experience preparing technical specifications, source-to-target mappings, business rules, lineage documentation, runbooks, or support procedures.

• Working knowledge of data governance, metadata, stewardship, reporting governance, access controls, and the secure handling of sensitive data.

• Strong analytical, critical-thinking, problem-solving, and communication skills.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively with both technical and business partners.

Education and Experience:

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, Data Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

• Five or more years of related experience in IT, business intelligence, data engineering, data integration, reporting, or analytics delivery.

• Experience developing and supporting enterprise data solutions in a production environment.

• Equivalent military experience may also be considered.

Lead-Level Opportunity:

Lead-level candidates will have greater depth in data integration, ETL/ELT, data modeling, data warehousing, data quality, and production support. They will also lead complex initiatives, guide technical decisions and standards, mentor team members, and coordinate the resolution of complex production issues.

Lead-level consideration generally requires seven or more years of related experience, leadership of multiple large-scale initiatives, and experience providing technical guidance to developers or analysts.

Lead Preferred Qualifications

• Master’s degree or relevant professional certification.

• Experience in insurance or another regulated data environment.

• Experience gathering and documenting business requirements.

• Experience with enterprise data warehouses, data marts, semantic layers, or governed datasets.

• Knowledge of data governance, lineage, data quality, and reporting governance.

• Experience with modern data platforms such as Azure, AWS, GCP, Snowflake, or Microsoft Fabric.

• For Lead-level consideration, experience mentoring others or improving BI development and support standards.

Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

title: Oliver Wyman - Senior Consultant (Generalist)
description:
Who we are

Oliver Wyman is a global leader in management consulting that combines deep industry knowledge with specialized expertise in strategy, operations, risk management, and organization transformation. Our mission is to help clients achieve lasting success by solving their most complex problems and seizing their biggest opportunities.

We believe in the power of diverse perspectives and collaborative teams to drive innovation and impact. Our consultants come from a range of backgrounds and experiences, and we embrace the unique skills and insights they bring to our work.

At Oliver Wyman, we are proud of the values that we aspire to live by. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their full potential.

What you will do

As a Senior Consultant, you will work alongside colleagues at all levels and with clients around the world to solve complex problems and drive meaningful change. You will lead significant components of client engagements, take ownership of complex analyses and workstreams, and translate insights into practical, high-impact recommendations.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Structuring complex business problems and developing analytical approaches to address them

• Conducting and overseeing research, interviews, surveys, and quantitative analyses

• Synthesizing findings into clear, actionable insights and recommendations

• Developing compelling, client-ready presentations and communications

• Leading defined project workstreams and managing deliverables, timelines, and quality

• Collaborating closely with clients and project teams to drive alignment and successful project outcomes

• Supporting implementation and helping clients translate recommendations into action

• Coaching and supporting more junior team members

• Contributing to practice development, intellectual capital, and knowledge-building initiatives

Generalist consultants have the opportunity to work across a range of industries and capabilities, building broad experience before aligning more closely with a practice area and deepening their expertise. Depending on business needs and project opportunities, this may include work across Consumer, Telecommunications and Technology, Energy and Natural Resources, Banking and Financial Services, Insurance and Asset Management, Health and Life Sciences, Performance Transformation, Private Capital, and Transportation and Advanced Industrials.

Why Join us?

• Join Oliver Wyman if you are energized by challenging problems, curious about different industries and perspectives, and excited to work across teams and cultures.

• Our consultants learn through hands-on client work as well as formal training designed to strengthen their analytical, communication, presentation, leadership, and client-management skills.

• You will be part of an open, inclusive, and down-to-earth culture where colleagues bring their authentic selves to work, challenge conventional thinking, and measure success by the lasting impact they create together. We value flexibility, including opportunities for hybrid working, and offer a range of employee resource groups, communities, and social activities.

• At Oliver Wyman, hierarchy should not stand in the way of great ideas or career progression. You will have opportunities to take on increasing responsibility, expand your capabilities, and shape your career as you grow.

Qualifications

We are looking for candidates who demonstrate strong problem-solving skills, leadership potential, and the ability to deliver high-quality work in dynamic, team-based environments.

• 2–4 years of relevant strategy consulting experience

• Demonstrated experience leading projects or significant workstreams within a strategy consulting firm

• Strong quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Strong client and stakeholder management capabilities

• Proven ability to collaborate effectively in team-based environments

Apply!

We are accepting applications for the following U.S. offices:

• Boston

• Chicago

• New York

Unrestricted U.S. work authorization is required. Oliver Wyman does not offer sponsorship for this position. Please note that CPT and OPT are restricted forms of work authorization that we cannot sponsor.

The applicable base salary range for this role is $135,000 to $155,000 USD. The base pay offered will be determined on factors such as experience, skills, training, location, certifications, and education, and any applicable minimum wage requirements. Decisions will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives.

We are excited to offer a competitive total rewards package which includes health and welfare benefits, tuition assistance, 401K savings and other retirement programs as well as employee assistance programs.

description:

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer - VoIP Infrastructure you will:
• Contribute to the design, development and implementation of VoIP infrastructure, telephony platforms, and observability features that power AI-driven voice workloads
• Collaborate with engineering, Product, and infrastructure teams to ensure our voice and AI platforms perform efficiently, scale reliably, and integrate seamlessly across SIP/RTP, Kamailio, RTPEngine, and related telecom systems.
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of the SRE practice by turning operational telephony and AI workload use cases into requirements for software tooling.
• Contribute to the execution of deployment and support activities for VoIP systems and AI/ML developers operating in production voice environments.
• Build high-quality, clean, scalable and reusable code by enforcing best practices around software engineering architecture and processes (Code Reviews, Unit testing, etc.).
• Work with product owners to understand detailed requirements and own your code from design, implementation, test automation, and delivery — spanning both telephony infrastructure and LLM integration layers.
• Experience integrating LLMs into voice platforms and real-time communication systems.
• Be a mentor for colleagues and help promote knowledge-sharing across telecom and AI engineering disciplines.
Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:
• Hands-on experience building VoIP systems using SIP/RTP protocols;
• Practical knowledge of Kamailio, RTPEngine, FreeSWITCH, SBCs, and PSTN systems (or similar);
• Working knowledge of PSTN infrastructure and telecom protocols;
• Experience integrating applications on top of LLMs (using existing models, not building them);
• Experience in prompt engineering and developing LLM based features
• 4+ years of development experience with Python, GoLang, Java or similar languages.
• 4+ years of experience operating highly available distributed workloads on Kubernetes following a DevOps approach.
• Working experience building distributed systems with cloud-native software;
• Experience with software-defined networking, infrastructure as code and configuration management;
• Experience with DevOps tooling (e.g. Helm / Ansible / Kubernetes / Prometheus /Splunk/ GitLab CI) is considered an asset
• Experience building software for compliance and security in regulated environments is considered an asset

title: Wealth Planning Analyst
description:
The Wealth Planning Analyst is an essential member of the wealth management team and serves as the starting point in the advisor career path. This role supports licensed advisors by coordinating client meetings, conducting research, preparing financial plans, and assisting with follow-up activities necessary for effective client wealth management. The Wealth Planning Analyst builds strong technical, analytical, and client service skills as part of their professional development toward becoming a licensed advisor.

Responsibilities:• Communicate with clients by answering basic questions, assisting with account access, and explaining reports or statements in a clear and professional manner.

• Support client service activities, including preparing paperwork, coordinating money movement requests, and processing account maintenance tasks.

• Provide overflow support to Client Service Associates during client onboarding, ensuring account documentation is complete, accurate, and timely.

• Coordinate scheduling for client meetings (both onsite and virtual) and manage related logistics.

• Prepare meeting agendas, assemble supporting materials, and ensure advisors are fully equipped for client discussions.

• Participate in client meetings by taking detailed notes, capturing action items, and assisting with follow-up deliverables.

• Gather and organize client financial data—including assets, liabilities, income, and expenses—to support advisor analysis.

• Enter client information into financial planning software and prepare initial plan drafts under the direction of licensed advisors.

• Assist in developing financial projections and “what-if” planning scenarios for advisor review.

• Research portfolio holdings, performance, fees, and asset allocation using firm-approved tools and resources.

• Prepare reports and summaries of research findings to support advisor recommendations.

QualificationsRequired Education and Experience:• Completed Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Financial Planning or related field preferred or completion within 6 months of hire.

• Internship experience within a financial planning or wealth management organization.

• Commitment to pursuing the Series 65 license within a defined timeframe after hire.

Preferred Education and Experience:• Interest in pursuing the CFP designation as part of long-term professional development.

Skills and Knowledge• Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality, professional client experience through clear communication, responsiveness, and follow-through.

• Familiarity with financial planning concepts and planning/investment software (e.g., eMoney, Holistiplan, Nitrogen or similar tools; formal training will be provided.

• Foundational knowledge of the wealth management process, including account types, investment vehicles, and core planning strategies, with a strong interest in deepening expertise.

• Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to balance academic commitments and professional responsibilities when applicable.

• Detail-oriented with solid analytical and problem-solving skills to support data gathering, plan development, and portfolio research.

• Clear and professional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to summarize findings for senior advisors.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint) and ability to quickly learn new systems and processes.

• Collaborative mindset with enthusiasm for learning and contributing as part of an advisor team.

• Commitment to professional growth and eventual progression into a client-facing advisor role.

title: Senior Financial Analyst-Financial Planning and Analysis
description:
You will have a primary role in assisting corporate areas with staff planning, expense budgeting & tracking, reporting of actual to plan variances, & additional FP&A tasks as assigned.

We’re seeking a self-motivated professional with technical and analytical skills to join our Financial Planning and Analysis team as a Senior Financial Analyst. If you’ve got a passion for helping others, our goal is to turn that passion into action. At Sentry, we care about delivering long-term results. Our associates embody this same future-focused approach – meeting challenges head-on and offering solutions and pricing that keeps customers coming back down the line.

This position will be located at our office in Stevens Point, WI in a hybrid work model and is not a fully remote opportunity.

For this position, Sentry does not offer employment to holders of F-1, J-1, and H-1 Visas.

What You'll Do

As a Senior Financial Analyst, you will:

• Review financial information, statements, and reports for accuracy and thoroughness and communicates results, in accordance with accounting principles and reporting schedules, to ensure the organization has a full and accurate statement of its financial position.
• Prepare unique or complex financial reporting to provide accurate and timely information for making financial decisions and ensuring compliance with relevant regulations, laws, and reporting requirements. These reports may include, but are not limited to profit and loss statements, balance sheets, depreciation statements, cash flow, debtor and creditor lists, repayment schedules, regulatory reports and filings.
• Coordinate the development of financial budgets and forecasts based on business, industry, competitor, and economic data trends and analysis. Identify areas of concern and help create corrective action plans.
• Advise management on opportunities or improvements to achieve desired objectives.
• Collaborate with business stakeholders to support strategic initiatives and goals
• Perform data projections, predict initiative and operating program impacts and provide recommendations and communicates plans.
• Recommend and implement changes in procedures and systems.
• Anticipate and develop ad-hoc analysis and reporting based on understanding of business and industry data and communicates results in effective manner to support business decisions.
• Analyze and interpret complex financial activity and variances, identifies trends and corrective actions, and makes recommendations to management.
• Provide technical advice on complex subjects within area of expertise to functional, operational area managers to help them develop revenue and expense budgets, understand financial reports, and manage their financial responsibilities.
• Provide basic advice in other related areas of expertise.
• Review and monitor financial activity, system interfaces, and reporting to ensure strong financial compliance to external rules and internal controls.
• Lead and participate in various projects providing project management, research and collaboration with multiple resources to address specific finance related needs/issues.

In addition, you will:

• Respond to inquiries regarding finance issues and programs. Interpret policy guidelines and plan documents, provides dialogue and advises the business on possible solutions.
• Provide work direction and learning opportunities to other team members and is relied upon to troubleshoot complex issues that are escalated from the team or referred from management. Act as a resource for team members with less experience.
• Perform other job-related duties as assigned from time to time

What it Takes

• Bachelor's degree in Financial Services required (Finance, Accounting, Actuarial Science or a related field).
• 5+ years of related work experience
• Applies broad and deep knowledge of financial practices with a solid understanding of business dynamics and variables.
• Expert ability to leverage financial accounting skills to prepare financial statements for internal and external stakeholders.
• Skilled ability to extract, transform, and analyze data to gain insights, improve predictions, and support decision making.
• Ability to serve as a valuable business partner to operational units outside of accounting/finance departments.
• Ability to plan and organize resources, both people and financial, to complete projects.
• Collaborate effectively with other teams to achieve positive results.
• Ability to effectively identify, analyze, and resolve problems. Skilled analytical, research, and documentation skills.
• Advanced knowledge of PC-based business software, including word processing, spreadsheet, database and presentation applications.
• Skilled ability to listen effectively and convey ideas through written and verbal communications.
• Proven experience in setting priorities and meeting deadlines.
• Certified Public Accountant (CPA) designation, or the ability to work towards attaining the designation (i.e. 150 credits), is highly encouraged.

At Sentry, your total rewards go beyond competitive compensation. We’re committed to supporting the whole you, which is why we offer a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive both professionally and personally.

• Hybrid Flexibility: Enjoy the best of both worlds. With optional work from home on Mondays and Fridays and join your team in the office Tuesday through Thursday to collaborate and learn. We provide the technology and tools you need for both your office and home workspace from day one.
• Dining on Us: Depending on your location, we may provide a stipend that can be used at our on-site cafeteria or a meal allowance to keep you fueled.
• Continuous Learning: Unlock your potential through Sentry University and take advantage of our tuition reimbursement program.
• Comprehensive Benefits: We support your whole self with group medical, dental, and vision insurance along with parental leave, pet insurance, caregiver leave, and wellness resources. Options for HSA, FSA, and Dependent Care FSA are available.
• Work-Life Balance: Enjoy your generous Paid Time Off allowance to rest and take advantage of paid Volunteer Time Off to support your community.
• Investing in Your Future: We’re committed to your long-term financial well-being. We offer a 100% company match on the first 8% you contribute to your 401(k) each pay period, and those funds vest immediately.
• Giving Back: Through the Sentry Foundation, we’re proud to support the United Way and make a difference in our communities.

Why Join Sentry?

At Sentry, we believe our people are the heart of our success. We’re proud to be recognized for the culture we’ve built, earning spots on Forbes’ lists for America’s Best Midsize Employers and Best Employers for New Grads, as well as Newsweek’s America’s Greatest Workplaces for Women and Diversity. These honors reflect our commitment to your professional satisfaction and growth.

Building on a Legacy

Our future is bright, but it’s anchored in a long history of stability. Since our founding in 1904, we’ve dedicated ourselves to helping businesses protect their futures. That trust has made us one of the largest and most financially stable mutual insurance companies in the U.S. We’re proud to have maintained an A+ rating from A.M. Best, the industry’s leading authority, for over 30 years.

Your Career, Our Community

Whether you’re working at our headquarters in Stevens Point, Wisconsin, or one of our many offices across the country, you’ll find a challenging and rewarding environment. Explore the Our Teams tab on our Career Page to see the diverse career paths we offer, with a focus on ongoing development and professional growth.

Ready to own your future? Join us at Sentry, opportunities await!

We're looking for our first Product hire: an experienced product leader who wants to own the product function end-to-end at a fast-growing fintech.

The Role
We're looking to make our first product hire; someone to work directly with the founders every day and own the roadmap, discovery, specs, launches - everything that makes a product successful.
Today, this is a hands-on role - not a management role. You will inherit a real product with real customers moving real money across a growing set of corridors, an experienced engineering team that ships fast, and a large backlog of decisions. As we scale, you'll build the product organization underneath you; today it's all hands on deck.
You'll hold two horizons at once: what ships this quarter, and where global money movement is going over the next three to five years. Which rails will matter, which regulatory shifts are coming, what we own versus rent. Today's decisions should serve that direction.
Lastly, because we sell infrastructure to technical buyers, this role sits close to the metal. You should be comfortable reading an API spec, reasoning about the failure modes of a payment flow, and arguing about idempotency and reconciliation with engineers who will push back.
You'll have the opportunity to:
• Own the roadmap. Set product direction across corridors, rails, and platform capabilities. Decide what we build, what we don't, and in what order — then defend those calls to the team, our customers, and our leadership.

• Run discovery with technical customers. Talk directly to the engineers and operators who integrate with us. Turn what they tell you into specs precise enough to build from.

• Define the core platform surfaces. Help create excellent payment orchestration, ledgering, payout and collection flows, partner integrations, public APIs, and much more.

• Turn regulation into product. Payment rules change, and they change our architecture. You'll work with engineering, compliance, and our banking and fintech partners to translate new requirements into product decisions with clear tradeoffs and timelines.

• Manage partner-facing product work. Every day we work with banks and financial partners. You'll scope integrations, negotiate capability gaps, and hold partners to their commitments.

• Set the product bar. Establish how we write specs, run launches, communicate roadmap, and make decisions. You'll define what shipping excellent software looks like.

• Cross-border payments, FX, and international money movement

• Domestic payment rails and scheme integrations (ACH, RTP, SEPA, SPEI, PIX, UPI, InstaPay/PESONet, or equivalents)

• Crypto and stablecoin infrastructure, and on/off-ramps

• Treasury, liquidity management, and ledgering

• Identity, fraud prevention, and compliance

• Experience shipping API-first or developer-facing products to technical buyers.

• Comfort in regulated environments. You've shipped alongside compliance and legal constraints and treated them as design inputs rather than obstacles.

• Technical expertise. You don't need to be a former engineer, but you need to be able to effectively lead a meeting full of engineers.

• Startup range. You've worked somewhere small and fast, and you're comfortable when the process you need doesn't exist yet.

• Strong writing. Specs, decision memos, launch notes. Much of this job is written.

• Empathy and strong character. We're building a collaborative, kind, high-achieving culture.

Preferred
• Background at a payments platform, PSP, money transmitter, or bank technology provider

• Experience taking a product from early design partners through repeatable go-to-market

• Experience hiring or building out a product function

• Fluency with AI-assisted workflows and modern product and engineering tooling

Why Latitude?
Rare Opportunity: We're backed by top investors (including NEA and Lightspeed Faction), finding significant traction, and taking on a massive market opportunity in international payments. First Product hires at companies like this are rare, and the leverage is real — you'll be shaping what gets built, not administering someone else's roadmap.
Real Ownership: You'll own the product function from day one, with direct access to the founders and no layer between you and the decisions.

Strong Team: Join a high-caliber team that combines deep fintech expertise with startup execution experience. Our team has worked on the stuff that matters at companies like Stripe, Coinbase, Uber, and Facebook.
